name: The User Types Hexad Scale - English (validated), survey and instructions

statement: The authors' distribution of the 24-item Hexad scale, citing Tondello et al. CHI PLAY 2016 (DOI 10.1145/2967934.2968082) and the 2018 IJHCS validation. Public source for all-source inference of index row B16.
